definitions.gloss: mourning; period of mourning after a death
definitions.explanation: The period of grief and abstention from celebrations following the death of a family member or close relative. Traditionally lasting 49 days in Buddhism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなり→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧、{喪|も}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服|ふく}している→服す：29104_fukusu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away and I am in mourning.

examples.japanese: {喪|も}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a custom of refraining from celebratory events until the mourning period ends.

notes:
{喪|も}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服|ふく}す→服す：29104_fukusu⟧ (to be in mourning) is the most common set phrase. The mourning period is called ⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喪|も}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服|ふく}す→服す：29104_fukusu⟧: to observe mourning, to be in mourning
- ⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧: in mourning (period)
- ⟦{喪服|もふく}→喪服：11898_mofuku⟧: mourning dress/clothes
- {喪主|もしゅ}: chief mourner
- {喪|も}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧: for the mourning period to end

USAGE:
⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧ is written on postcards (喪中⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧) sent to notify people that the sender will not be sending New Year's greeting cards.
